environment.description: EKS pod running in a managed node group with IMDSv1 enabled (HttpTokens: optional). Pod uses default service account with IAM role attached via IRSA. The IAM role has dynamodb:GetItem permission on the UserProfiles table with no leading attribute conditions. NetworkPolicy allows all egress from the pod namespace. No istio sidecar or envoy proxy filtering outbound connections. CoreDNS serves external DNS queries without restriction.
